items.title: AMD Stock Rises as CFO Claims Its Addressable Market Could Reach $3 Trillion
items.summary: Investors were piling into the chip designer after its CFO said that artificial-intelligence demand will drive a total market for AMD’s products to around $3 trillion in 2030.

items.title: AMD shares surge as chipmaker eyes $2 trillion AI market
items.summary: Investing.com -- Advanced Micro Devices shares jumped roughly 7% on Tuesday after management outlined an aggressive artificial-intelligence growth strategy at the Citi Global TMT Conference, anchored by a new $2 trillion total addressable market estimate by 2030. At the core of AMD’s thesis is a pivotal shift in the AI landscape. Computing demand is rapidly transitioning from training large AI models to executing them—a process known as inference. items.summary: Stocks declined on Tuesday as oil prices rose, renewing investor worries about hotter inflation and bolstering the case for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates.  Investor attention may turn to  Apple  on Wednesday when the company holds its iPhone launch event.  Artificial-intelligence stocks were advancing despite the market’s inflation worries.
